answer_4.quote: Three authors of this paper serve as human annotators and we use the Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk) sandbox as our preferred annotation platform.
answer_4.guideline: For every instance, we ask annotators the following two questions related to the types of observed errors in reasoning explanations: Intrinsic Errors: Is the explanation fully derivable from the input entities and their corresponding matching label, irrespective of whether it contains excess information? Extrinsic Errors: Does the explanation contain information in excess of the entity descriptions and their corresponding matching labels?
